description: This is a JUnit test class for the InitializationFilter component in the OpenMRS web application. It tests the behavior of initialization logic related to configuration properties, environment variables, and installation scripts.

classes.name: InitializationFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of InitializationFilter in different scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, instantiating InitializationFilter and its associated model.

methods.name: shouldLoadConnectionUrlFromProperties
methods.description: Test that the connection URL is loaded from the injected property.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clears system properties after each test to avoid side effects.

methods.name: shouldPrioritizeSystemPropertiesOverEnvironmentAndScript
methods.description: Verifies that system properties override environment variables and installation script properties.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldNormalizeEnvironmentVariablesCorrectly
methods.description: Checks correct normalization of environment variables into the wizard model.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldKeepSpecialEnvironmentKeysWithoutNormalization
methods.description: Ensures that specific environment keys like INSTALL_METHOD are kept as-is.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldFallbackToInstallScriptWhenNotInSystemOrEnvironment
methods.description: Tests fallback logic to properties from the installation script.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldReturnNullForNonExistingProperties
methods.description: Verifies behavior when properties are missing in environment and script.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldMergePropertiesFromSystemEnvAndInstallScript
methods.description: Tests merging of environment variables, system properties, and installation script properties into the wizard model.

methods.name: initializeWizardFromResolvedPropertiesIfPresent_shouldInitializeWizardModelCorrectlyFromProperties
methods.description: Checks that the wizard model is correctly populated from a set of properties.
